evidence_class: recorded replay of a live stream; the live capture itself (unsanitized) is private steward evidence under plans/evidence/2026-10-21-accept-1-live/
cli_version_basis: reported by the selected source (cli_version declaration); not known at launch, no version command was run
mode_and_route: CliCapture launch (opt-in integration): raw stdout, independent byte copy, flush per record
capture_command: Create five files one at a time in the current directory with the Write tool: f1.txt, f2.txt, f3.txt, f4.txt, f5.txt, each containing exactly its own file name. After writing each file, read it back with the Read tool before writing the next one. Finally reply with one line: "done: 5 files".
scenario: five sequential Write/Read pairs; the capture cancelled the CLI deliberately after 12 records (SIGTERM via the process handle; claude exited 143); acquisition interrupted, recording INTERRUPTED

live_process.exit_meaning: 143 (128+15): terminated by signal 15 under the usual shell convention (Java reports the code, not the signal)
live_process.meaning: the CLI process outcome; distinct from storage finalization (recording.state) and acquisition extent (acquisition.status): EOF never implies success

rate_limit_event account utilization/resetsAt -> 0 (account status is not fixture data)
